purpose: Select Quranic morphology, build dependency and phrase graphs, enforce all observed relation and phrase contracts, validate typed grammar and diacritics, and perform bounded additive diacritization.
invariants: Dependency direction is dependent to head.
All 45 dependency relations and six phrase families have executable non-normative contracts.
Unsupported generated edges remain Unverified and cannot establish verified core structure.
Phrase intervals must resolve, be unique, and remain laminar.
Runtime validation binds the contract-set ID and root and returns only Valid, Invalid, or Unverified.
Constraint discovery returns typed contracts by graph claim or rule ID under the same ID/root binding.
Correction requests never mutate the graph and remain fail closed when no approved correction policy exists.
NormativeCns mode cannot accept non-normative contracts.
All named lexeme allowlists are classified per entry as evidence-only or explicit natural-Arabic heuristic data.
Natural-Arabic heuristic fallback is disabled by default and any opt-in result remains Unverified.
Morphology selection factors, rationales, beam bound, and tie-breakers are bound by score policy v1.
Surface-incompatible canonical case evidence emits ADG-QC2004 and is unverified.
Diacritization is additive-only and preserves morphology, graph, and rule fingerprints.
